usage: 風琴 is the standard noun for an organ, especially a church organ or a keyboard instrument with organ sounds.
It is a countable noun in English teaching terms: you can refer to one 風琴, but in real speech people often talk about the instrument as a general class.
This word is relatively formal and school-friendly; in everyday conversation, people may still say 風琴 when talking about the instrument, especially in music lessons.
Commonly used with verbs like 彈、學、聽、演奏, and with contexts such as music class, church, concerts, and instrument practice.
